summary.text: Anna Howard is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 21, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an immigrant, a CPA and educator, and a community volunteer.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Howard said she came to the United States from the Soviet Union as a young woman, earned her business education here, became a CPA and CMA, and built a career in accounting and learning that includes teaching college students.

She said she lives in Portsmouth and has served through the Portsmouth Economic Development Commission, South Church, the Senior Activity Center, local schools, and civic and social justice organizations.
Howard advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is the only candidate listed for the district in the general election.
In the survey, she said she wants to reduce pressure on property taxpayers, strengthen public education, expand affordable housing and childcare, and support workers and local businesses.
She also said she is especially passionate about human rights and protecting democracy.
